verdict.rationale: Signifyd's API includes endpoints to report chargeback and representment outcomes back to Signifyd (docs-5, docs-6), which is the kind of confirmed-fraud outcome data that could feed a learning loop, but there is no explicit documentation stating that analyst review decisions or these outcomes are used to retrain the model or update rules. missing for 10: explicit statement that analyst decisions/outcomes update the ML model or rules engine, documentation of a closed feedback loop, evidence of rule/model versioning tied to case outcomes.
